text: dsh-typography 是面向 DSH Web UI 的字体自定义插件，在设置的通用字体面板中分别管理界面字体和代码字体。用户可以选择 Inter、JetBrains Mono、IBM Plex Sans、Fira Code、Noto Sans SC 等在线预设，也可导入自定义字体链接，或从本地字体库快速应用 woff2、ttf、otf 文件。选择会保存在浏览器本地，并通过 CSS 字体变量即时生效；host 部分提供本地字体索引和文件服务。适合希望调整阅读体验或代码显示的 DSH 用户。在线预设需要访问 jsDelivr；本地字体功能使用 DSH 字体目录，不需要 API key。

dsh-typography lets DSH Web users choose interface and code fonts independently. Select online presets, import font URLs, or use local woff2, ttf, and otf files. Choices persist in browser storage and update the UI font variables. Online presets load from jsDelivr; no API key is needed.

dsh-typography 的功能「独立字体选择」：在设置界面分别为 UI 和代码选择系统默认、内置预设或自定义字体，选择后即时更新对应字体变量。
dsh-typography 的功能「本地字体库」：将 woff2、ttf 或 otf 文件放入 DSH 字体目录后，设置面板读取可用文件列表，用户可将其添加到字体选择中。
dsh-typography 的功能「自定义字体导入」：在对应字体组录入字体名称、链接和字重后添加；支持 http(s) 或同源字体链接，并保存选择以便刷新后恢复。
dsh-typography 的功能「在线字体预设」：在界面字体组或代码字体组选择 Inter、IBM Plex Sans、Noto Sans SC 等组合，插件注入字体规则并更新对应 CSS 变量。
dsh-typography 使用前须知：在线预设字体文件从 jsDelivr 加载，需要网络连接；离线时字体栈会回退到系统字体。

dsh-typography README · 简介：DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的字体入口是两个 CSS 变量：`--dsw-font-family`（界面）与 `--ds-font-family-code`（代码），全部组件经 `var()` 消费。dsh-typography 把它们变成两组**互相独立**的选择：

dsh-typography README · 简介：- **界面字体 / 代码字体分开管**：各自的预设卡片、导入编辑器与持久化状态，互不影响
- **在线预设**：Inter + JetBrains Mono、IBM Plex Sans + Fira Code、Noto Sans SC（简中全覆盖）；字体文件经 jsDelivr CDN 分发，离线自动回退系统字体栈
- **本地字体库**：把任意 `woff2/ttf/otf` 丢进 `%DSH_HOME%\typography\`，刷新后一键应用 —— **TTF 直接可用，无需转 woff2**
- **可变字体友好**：字重可选“可变·全字重”，生成 `font-weight: 100 900` 的 `@font-face`，粗细真实呈现
- **默认即放手**：某组选“默认”时不输出任何样式，可与其它字体类插件共存
- **跨 DSH 版本兼容**：适配 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2——`defineStore` 引擎位于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`，但该包不带 `dsh.client` 声明、不会进入客户端模块表，因此插件内置最小快照 store 引擎（动作签名与官方契约一致：`(draft, ...args) => void`）；`dsh.client.inject` 只声明各版本都提供的核心服务（slots / locale）

完整类型见 `lib/types/client/index.d.ts`。

dsh-typography README · 工作原理：- 浏览器半边 `apply` 时通过 `ctx.provide("typography", registry)` 挂出注册表；选择变更时重写注入的 `<style id="dsh-typography-style">`：`@font-face` 规则 + 仅覆盖非默认组的 CSS 变量
- host 半边通过 `ctx.webServer` 注册 `/plugins/dsh-typography/files/*` 路由，分发 `%DSH_HOME%\typography` 下的字体文件（按扩展名给出 `font/woff2 | font/ttf | font/otf`；`?list=1` 返回索引 JSON）
- 选择持久化在 `localStorage`（`dsh-typography:prefs`），启动时恢复；恢复时忽略已失效的预设 id
- 设置行经 `ctx.slots` 注册进 Settings → General 的 item 槽位（id `typography`），文案走 `ctx.locale` 双语字典

dsh-typography README · 已知限制：- 在线预设需要联网；离线时沿字体栈尾部回退系统字体
- 本地库文件名需以字母/数字开头（Unicode 字母即可，中文文件名可用）
- 少量组件硬编码了 `Inter, var(--dsw-font-family)` 优先栈（如工作区浏览器），装了 Inter 的系统上这些位置仍显示 Inter
- 与 dsh-fonts 同时安装时：任一组选中预设/自定义即以本组为准（本插件样式表排在其后）；只想要其一可 `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove <另一插件>`

dsh-typography README · Introduction：The DeepSeek Harness Web UI exposes two font entry points as CSS variables: `--dsw-font-family` (interface) and `--ds-font-family-code` (code), consumed by every component through `var()`. dsh-typography turns them into two **fully independent** selections:

dsh-typography README · Introduction：- **Separate interface / code fonts**: each group has its own preset cards, import editor, and persisted state
- **Online presets**: Inter + JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Sans + Fira Code, Noto Sans SC (full Simplified Chinese coverage); font files ship via the jsDelivr CDN and fall back to system stacks offline
- **Local font library**: drop any `woff2/ttf/otf` into `%DSH_HOME%\typography\`, refresh, apply with one click — **TTF works directly, no woff2 conversion needed**
- **Variable-font friendly**: pick "variable · all weights" to emit a `font-weight: 100 900` descriptor with real weight rendering
- **Hands-off defaults**: a group set to "Default" writes no styles at all, coexisting with other font plugins
- **Cross-DSH-version compatibility**: adapted for DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 — the `defineStore` engine lives in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, but that package carries no `dsh.client` declaration and never becomes a row in the client module table, so the plugin bundles its own minimal snapshot store engine (action signature matches the official contract: `(draft, ...args) => void`); `dsh.client.inject` only declares the core services present in eve

dsh-typography README · Usage：This is a dual-face plugin: the host half serves local font files while the browser half provides the registry and settings row. After install it appears under **Settings → General → Fonts (interface / code)**.

```ts
const typography = ctx.get("typography")
// two independent groups: "ui" | "code"
typography?.select("code", "inter-jetbrains")
typography?.setCustom("ui", [

Full types live in `lib/types/client/index.d.ts`.

dsh-typography README · How it works：- On `apply` the browser half publishes the registry via `ctx.provide("typography", registry)`; selection changes rewrite the injected `<style id="dsh-typography-style">` sheet: `@font-face` rules plus CSS-variable overrides for non-default groups only
- The host half registers `/plugins/dsh-typography/files/*` through `ctx.webServer`, serving files from `%DSH_HOME%\typography` (`font/woff2 | font/ttf | font/otf` by extension; `?list=1` returns the index JSON)
- Selections persist in browser `localStorage` (`dsh-typography:prefs`) and are restored on boot; stale preset ids are ignored during restore
- The settings row registers into the Settings → General item slot (`ctx.slots`, id `typography`) with bilingual copy from `ctx.locale`

dsh-typography README · Known limitations：- Online presets need internet; offline they fall back along the stack tail to system fonts
- Library file names must start with a letter/digit (Unicode letters fine; Chinese names work)
- A few components hardcode an `Inter, var(--dsw-font-family)` head (e.g. the workspace browser) and still show Inter where it is installed
- When installed alongside dsh-fonts: any non-default selection here wins for its variables (our sheet mounts later); to keep only one, `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove <the-other>`
